LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Exit Rajiv Chowk Metro Station via Gate No. 5 (Palika Bazaar / Janpath side)
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Take escalator up, turn right past the Delhi Police tourist booth
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Avoid Gate 1 during peak hours (5-7 PM); Gate 5 has wider ramps & smoother flow.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Walk straight along Radial Road 3 past the famous Indian Coffee House
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Look for the red-brick heritage arcade on your left
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Stay inside the covered colonnade for shade during hot afternoons.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Turn left at the Hanuman Mandir crossing towards Gujarati Street Market
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Directly opposite the century-old floral garland sellers and sweet shop
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Cross via the pedestrian zebra crossing; vehicles turn fast on Connaught Outer Circle.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Board a shared E-Rickshaw from the designated electric stand
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: E-Rickshaw driver stand near SBI ATM kiosk (Pay fixed ₹10 per seat)
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: UPI QR code is pasted behind the driver seat. No cash change needed!

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Enter the narrow pedestrian lane (Gali) opposite Sharma Sweet Corner
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Under the decorative arched doorway; 40m walk into courtyard
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Two-wheelers & pedestrians only. Destination main entrance is on right with brass bell.
LandmarkNavStep.cautionAlert: Ignore touts offering duplicate guide passes; official ASI QR counter is inside the courtyard.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Arrive in Jaipur from $origin via Vande Bharat Express or Highway Taxi
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Jaipur Junction Railway Portico / Sindhi Camp Hub
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Prepaid E-Rickshaws and Metro connect directly to the Pink City.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Take Jaipur Metro Pink Line from Sindhi Camp to Badi Chaupar
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Exit Gate 2 opens right in front of Hawa Mahal facade
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Tap Smart Card or scan UPI QR code at the turnstile.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Walk through the shaded arcade to City Palace and Jantar Mantar
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Follow pedestrian Pink City heritage corridor
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Keep hat and sunglasses handy for open courtyards.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Arrive in Goa at Dabolim / Mopa Airport or Madgaon Station from $origin
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Goa Tourism Prepaid Taxi / Airport AC Electric Bus Bay
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Take the Kadamba Electric AC Airport shuttle to Panaji or Calangute for ₹150.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Pick up self-drive scooter or EV cab from designated hub
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Authorized Goa RTO Tourist Scooter Stand
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Always wear helmet; Goa traffic police conduct routine checks along coastal roads.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Arrive in Varanasi from $origin via Vande Bharat / Shiv Ganga Express
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Take the new Ropeway or E-Rickshaw from Cantt station directly to Godowlia Chowk.

LandmarkNavStep.instruction: Walk through the no-vehicle heritage zone of Godowlia to Dashashwamedh Ghat
LandmarkNavStep.landmarkCue: Follow pedestrian street lined with silk saree and sweet shops
LandmarkNavStep.streetSmartTip: Vehicles prohibited in Godowlia inner circle between 9 AM - 9 PM for peaceful walking.

MultimodalLeg.tip: Board Coach 2-3 for easiest exit stairs
Fixed fare ₹15; scan UPI QR code
Pass security check with digital ASI ticket
Ask driver to turn on meter (₹30 first 1.5km + ₹11/km)
Pink ticket free for female travelers; UPI accepted on One Delhi App
